def solve():
    balance = Q(180000)
    rate = Q("0.045")
    months = Q(24)
    cash = Q(50000)
    prepay = Q(5000)
    allowance = balance * Q("0.15")
    fee = max(prepay - allowance, Q(0)) * Q("0.02")
    post_balance = balance - prepay
    remaining_cash = cash - prepay - fee
    loan_interest = post_balance * rate * months / 12
    offset_raw = remaining_cash * Q("0.04") * months / 12
    offset = min(offset_raw, loan_interest)
    net = loan_interest - offset + fee
    return {
        "final": net,
        "prepayment_fee_usd": fee,
        "loan_interest_usd": loan_interest,
        "offset_credit_usd": offset,
    }

def solve():
    balance = Q(180000)
    loan_rate = Q("0.045")
    months = Q(24)
    cash = Q(50000)
    prepay = Q(5000)
    allowance = balance * Q("0.15")  # fee-free allowance based on the original balance
    fee = max(prepay - allowance, Q(0)) * Q("0.02")
    post_balance = balance - prepay
    remaining_cash = cash - prepay - fee  # fee is paid from cash
    interest = post_balance * loan_rate * months / 12
    credit = remaining_cash * Q("0.04") * months / 12
    credit = min(credit, interest)  # credit cannot exceed loan interest
    net = interest - credit + fee
    return {
        "final": net,
        "prepayment_fee_usd": fee,
        "loan_interest_usd": interest,
        "offset_credit_usd": credit,
    }
